## About
Cisco Trujillo opened this shop in Plano to go against the grain of the shady mechanic. We're family owned and operated, and Cisco is an ASE certified master technician.
We follow the recommendations in your owner's manual, so small problems get caught before they turn into big repairs. When something does need fixing, we walk you through it and talk over repair options that fit your budget.
We work on all types of makes and models, foreign and domestic, from Toyota and Honda to Mercedes-Benz and BMW. Rated 4.8 from 83 Google reviews.

## Services
- Oil changes: Regular oil changes to keep your engine reliable and efficient.
- Brake repair: We fix brakes that are worn or not working right.
- Battery checks and tire rotations: Routine upkeep, plus fluid top-ups, so we can catch issues early.
- Engine diagnostics: In-depth diagnostics to find the real problem before it becomes a major one.
- Transmission repair: Repair for transmission issues, handled with precision and care.
- Electrical repairs: Repair for your vehicle's electrical system when something isn't working right.
- Air conditioning service: Service for your car's air conditioning.
- Suspension work: Suspension diagnosis and repair, including hard to pin down problems.

## FAQ
Q: What makes do you work on?
A: All types of makes and models, foreign and domestic, including Toyota, Nissan, Mercedes-Benz, Lexus, Honda, Ford, Dodge, Chevrolet and BMW.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Are you BBB accredited?
A: Yes. We're a BBB Accredited Auto Repair Services Member.

Q: How do I request service?
A: Fill out the service request form on our site with your name, email and a short message about your car, and we'll get back to you.

## What customers say

The owner went above and beyond - he personally came to pick up my car (I live about 2 miles away) and kept it at the shop to continue testing and trying to reproduce the issue. The entire process took quite a long time, but despite all the effort and time spent, he didn’t charge me any labor fees since the root cause hadn’t been fully confirmed yet. That level of honesty and integrity is something you don’t see often.

Another thing I truly appreciated is their patience and kindness. English is not my first language, and I’m not familiar with automotive terms at all. The owner and his team took the time to explain everything clearly, multiple times if needed, and made sure I fully understood. That made me feel very comfortable and built a lot of trust. In the past, I’ve had stressful experiences with other shops due to communication barriers, but this was completely different.

We discussed repair options that fit within our budget, and the work is still ongoing - but even at this stage, I already feel confident recommending them. I’ve already referred several of my coworkers to this shop.

This is, without a doubt, the best auto repair experience I’ve ever had. Highly, highly recommend!" (Vicky Liu, 5/5)
